summary: Iteration 5 (MCQ wizard + sequential routing lock + decentralized inventory + tri-party reconciliation + wastage portal) tested. Backend: 8/8 NEW pytest tests PASS on /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_inventory_mcq.py covering dark-stores list, kit checkout w/ atomic store decrement, get-kit, MCQ report (Cough/Respiratory + 1-3 Days + Moderate => urgency=urgent + suggested OTC cetirizine_10), visit propagation of mcq_answers, validate-supply (ok=true, cetirizine_10 in needed, missing=[]), sequential lock (feed=[] while accepted/en_route/arrived), tri-party end-visit (kit decremented, inventory_transactions logged, visit status=completed + dispensed_receipt attached + invoice exists), wastage create/list, and 400 for unknown item. Frontend: MCQ wizard route /patient/symptom renders step 1 with all 5 category options (data-testid=option-category-*) as required. All required testIDs verified in source: option-{step.key}-{opt}, book-with-report-button, report-summary, ai-summary-{visitId} (BOTH doctor/index.tsx L177 AND doctor/active.tsx L204), raw-mcq-{visitId} (BOTH doctor/index.tsx L197 AND doctor/active.tsx L232), qr-scan-button, rescan-button, store-{id}, kit-item-{id}, open-wastage-button, confirm-wastage, advance-button-{visitId}, dispense-{id}, skip-dispense, confirm-end-visit. The doctor/active testID gap flagged in iteration_5.json is CLOSED. No P0/P1 bugs found.

issues: Duration option label uses en-dash (U+2013) '1–3 days' instead of hyphen. Functionally fine, but the value sent to the backend MCQ endpoint becomes '1–3 days' (en-dash) — the spec example uses regular hyphen '1-3 Days'. The /api/symptom-check/{sid}/report-mcq endpoint accepts any free string for duration so it still works, but the raw-mcq panel will display the en-dash version. Recommend normalising to '1-3 Days' for display/consistency with spec.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/dark-stores returns 3 seeded hubs (Indiranagar/Koramangala/HSR) with inventory dict — verified at runtime.

server.py POST /doctors/{id}/kit/checkout (L1177) correctly validates store stock per item BEFORE decrementing, then $inc decrements each item. Atomicity caveat: the pre-check and decrement are two separate phases — under concurrent checkout race two doctors could both pass pre-check then over-decrement. Not a problem at MVP scale but worth noting.

server.py POST /visits/end (L1242) implements tri-party reconciliation: deducts from doctor_kits.items, inserts inventory_transactions (type='dispensed_to_patient'), sets visit.status=completed, attaches dispensed_receipt, ensures invoice, and updates invoice.dispensed list. Verified end-to-end via pytest.

server.py /visits/doctor/feed (L427-436) sequential lock: counts accepted/en_route/arrived for doctor_id and returns [] if any exist. Verified in test_validate_and_end_visit — feed=[] when doc-5 had an accepted visit.

server.py /api/symptom-check/{sid}/report-mcq (L711) deterministic mapping: Severe->asap, Moderate->urgent, Mild->routine; triage='emergency' iff Severe AND <24h. SUGGESTED_MEDS_BY_CATEGORY is a static dict so report generation is instant (no LLM call). Stores mcq_answers on the report doc for downstream visit propagation.
server.py /api/visits (L386) — when symptom_report_id present, copies summary + overrides urgency + symptoms from report; mcq_answers passes through from payload independently. Both verified.
Frontend doctor/index.tsx L177 + L197 and doctor/active.tsx L204 + L232 each render BOTH ai-summary-{v.id} AND raw-mcq-{v.id} panels — iteration-5 spec satisfied on both feed and active screens.

Frontend doctor/inventory.tsx empty state shows qr-scan-button + opens scanModal with store-{s.id} buttons; filled state shows kit-item-{id} + rescan-button + wastage section with open-wastage-button + confirm-wastage. Matches spec.

Frontend doctor/active.tsx end-visit modal: advance-button-{v.id} -> opens dispense modal with +/- qty pickers per dispense-{id} row, skip-dispense and confirm-end-visit buttons. Confirm calls /api/visits/end with dispensed payload. Spec satisfied.

server.py app.include_router(api_router) is called TWICE (L1156 and L1343). The second call re-includes the same router after the inventory routes are appended. Idempotent because FastAPI appends each call's routes to app.routes — but it does cause every endpoint to be registered twice (and visible twice in /docs). NOT functional bug but cosmetic. Recommend: move app.include_router(api_router) to the bottom only, after all route declarations.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 is functionally complete. doc-5 has a live kit checked out from ds-koramangala. If you need a fresh sequential-lock test, use a different doctor (doc-1 through doc-4). The MCQ-wizard duration option strings contain U+2013 en-dashes (e.g., '1–3 days') — when writing Playwright selectors, copy from /app/frontend/app/patient/symptom.tsx STEPS[1].options verbatim or use '...replace(/\s/g, "-")' to construct testIDs. The /symptom-check/{sid}/report-mcq endpoint is purely deterministic (no LLM) so it returns in <100ms — no need for the 60s timeouts used in iteration 4 LLM tests. Sequential routing lock only checks accepted/en_route/arrived statuses; completed visits do NOT lock the feed.
